message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have successfully retrieved the calendars for both Priya Raman and Marcus Hale. My next step is to identify all the common 30-minute slots they have available during the specified week.

**Step 1: Consolidate Busy Times**
I will merge the busy schedules for both partners for each day. The working hours are 9:00 to 17:00.

*   **Monday, Nov 16:**
    *   Priya: 10:00-13:00, 14:00-17:00
    *   Marcus: 10:00-11:00, 11:30-17:00
    *   Combined Busy: The union of these times is 10:00-17:00.
    *   **Free:** 09:00-10:00. (Slots: 09:00, 09:30)

*   **Tuesday, Nov 17:**
    *   Priya: 09:00-10:30, 11:00-13:00, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:30
    *   Marcus: 09:00-11:00, 11:30-13:00, 14:00-15:30, 16:00-16:30
    *   Combined Busy: 09:00-11:00, 11:30-13:00 (Priya's 11:00-11:30 slot makes the combined busy time start at 11:00), so 09:00-13:00. Then 14:00-15:30 and 16:00-16:30.
    *   **Free:** 13:00-14:00 (Slots: 13:00, 13:30), 15:30-16:00 (Slot: 15:30)

*   **Wednesday, Nov 18:**
    *   Priya: 09:00-12:30, 13:00-15:00, 16:00-17:00
    *   Marcus: 09:30-12:00, 12:30-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:00-17:00
    *   Combined Busy: 09:00-15:00, 16:00-17:00.
    *   **Free:** 15:00-16:00. (Slots: 15:00, 15:30)

*   **Thursday, Nov 19:**
    *   Priya: 09:30-10:00, 10:30-14:30, 15:00-17:00
    *   Marcus: 09:00-10:00, 10:30-12:00, 12:30-13:30, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-17:00
    *   Priya Free Times: 09:00-09:30, 10:00-10:30, 14:30-15:00
    *   Marcus Free Times: 10:00-10:30, 12:00-12:30, 13:30-14:00, 14:30-15:00
    *   **Common Free:** 10:00-10:30 (Slot: 10:00), 14:30-15:00 (Slot: 14:30)

*   **Friday, Nov 20:**
    *   Priya: 09:00-11:00, 12:00-13:00, 13:30-14:00, 14:30-17:00
    *   Marcus: 09:00-11:00, 12:00-14:30, 15:00-17:00
    *   Combined Busy: 09:00-11:00, 12:00-17:00.
    *   **Free:** 11:00-12:00. (Slots: 11:00, 11:30)

**Step 2: Format the list for Brad**
I'll compile a clear list of the available 30-minute slots (start times) for Brad to check against his partners' calendars.

*   Mon: 09:00, 09:30
*   Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 15:30
*   Wed: 15:00, 15:30
*   Thu: 10:00, 14:30
*   Fri: 11:00, 11:30

This is a good number of options to start with. I will now append this information to the workspace.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
